fact: The Deputy Minister of Health held a coordination meeting with Vodafone, the communications ministry and the universal health insurance authority on digital integration to lay the foundations for the national digital health strategy, and the ministry spokesman said it stressed activating the health information exchange (HIE), with a wider workshop proposed.

Daily News Egypt reports the Ministry of Health and Population proposed an Egypt Smart Healthcare Platform to connect health facilities and share patient histories between them, and officials discussed launching a pilot for the first phase; no cost or timetable was disclosed.

The Egypt Healthcare Authority states an electronic referral system from primary healthcare units and centres to higher levels of service has been implemented in the universal health insurance provinces.

The National Health Compact commits Egypt to integrating databases between the Ministry of Social Solidarity and the Universal Health Insurance Authority to enrol Takaful and Karama beneficiaries into UHIS by 2030.
